tooling.probe: Python GI Atspi 2.0 desktop traversal over /run/user/1000/at-spi/bus_0

surfaceClasses.evidence: After the executable semantic gallery and shared control attachments were loaded on metal, Python GI Atspi traversal exposed applications xdg-desktop-portal-gtk, udiskie, and quickshell; every application reported zero children. Source-level name, role, description, and action attachments are therefore present but not observable by an assistive client. The metal Qt Accessible attached type also rejects a value property; progress carries numeric state in its accessible description as an explicit fallback, not as value-interface proof.

latestProbe.surface: Omarchy shell – dev gallery, executable quality matrix

surfaceClasses.blocker: Qt/Quickshell Wayland accessibility objects are not exported into the AT-SPI tree, and a numeric AT-SPI value interface has not been implemented. QML Accessible attachments in the gallery therefore cannot yet be observed or validated by an assistive client.

releaseGate.rule: All four surface classes must be implemented and proved in a disposable VM; absent tooling, absent semantics, blocked records, and missing records are failures rather than skips.
